rulings.why: Text plainly makes it a virtuoso instrument (+1 item bonus to Performance with it); nothing on the record delivers that, and `situational` is a legal item field consumed by explain.ts authoredSituational for equipped items, shape identical to shrieking-key.
Invested graft granting an owner-side 1d8 piercing horn Strike; grantedStrikes is the exact lane and the shape matches whip-tail field for field.
Usage 'worn armor', Base Armor Full Plate, yet itemType 'equipment' with no acBonus at all — the wearer gets zero AC; the fix copies full-plate's legal armor fields verbatim.
Same defect and same well-formed armor-statistics fix; the built-in resilient rune correctly stays prose like the other 130+ named magic armors.
Typed 'equipment' with no armor statistics, so equipping delivers nothing; acBonus/dexCap/checkPenalty/speedPenalty/strength are all legal item fields and are copied from full-plate.
Same missing-armor-statistics defect; fix is the base full-plate block and does not over-grant (the +2 greater resilient stays prose).

Relic gift that casts fly ON the owner once per hour; spellId 'fly' exists, usesPer:'hour' is the shape elemental-wayfinder-air already ships, and sibling relic gifts living-storm/living-statue already use innateSpells.
Owner casts 5th-rank wall of stone once per day and nothing grants it; 'wall-of-stone' exists with a primal tradition and the innateSpells shape matches living-statue.

The fix names 'kitContents' plus a 'where' note, neither of which is a legal item field, and the backfill applier has no lane for code tables (its categories are feats/classFeatures/items/heritages/backgrounds/classes/spells/actions/deities) — applied as written it would add junk to the record and deliver nothing; the real remedy is KIT_CONTENTS in src/rules/play.ts, a code change, not an item field.

Six knots is a finite owner-side pool that never refills, the record has no frequency so itemUses.ts synthesizes nothing, and a bespoke counter with resetsOnRest:false is the established shape (miter-of-communion, bloodstride-boots).

OVER-GRANT: passiveEffects.speedPenalty is applied by deriveSpeeds unconditionally to EVERY movement type for any worn/equipped/invested item, but the surcoat's text only increases the Speed penalty OF YOUR ARMOR — it does nothing without medium/heavy armor and should interact with the armor's Strength threshold (derive.ts:1956-1967). No legal item field expresses a conditional armor-penalty increase, so the record cannot carry this correctly.

A once-per-10-minutes owner-side heal with no frequency field, so nothing synthesizes a charge; a bespoke counter carrying the cadence in the label is exactly the bloodstride-boots shape and the sibling handwraps all ship counters.

Genuine 8-hour owner-side state with a fromItemId (so it is visible), matching the note-only mode precedent — but the judge's object omits `modifiers`, which all 398 shipped modes carry; corrected fix adds it.

mode.name: Siphon Chill
mode.note: For 8 hours you treat extreme cold as severe cold. The activation also removes the fatigued condition if it was caused by exposure to environmental cold.

rulings.why: AoN confirms Decaying adds 1d4 void on every hit, the `decaying` entry in core.runes carries no damage, and the blade grants the effect without an etched rune — a weapon's own strikeDamage is the documented intrinsic lane (types.ts:1137-1140, Hyldarf's Fang).

Three at-will innate arcane cantrips and no innateSpells on the record; the AoN mirror (equipment-478) confirms detect magic / mage hand / prestidigitation, all three ids resolve here (detect-magic, telekinetic-hand, prestidigitation), and atWill with no rank is the precedented auto-heighten shape.
A printed 9-ranks-per-day pool the owner spends across activations; the record has no frequency so nothing is synthesized, and {id,label,max,per,resetsOnRest} is the standard counter shape.

Built-in corrosive rune delivers nothing: runes live on the inventory instance (types.ts:1912), not the item definition, so the 1d6 acid has no route except the weapon's own strikeDamage; appliesTo defaults to 'all' in strikeDamageRiders, so the shape is correct.
Same defect; corrosive-greater in core.runes also carries 1d6 acid, so the per-hit rider is the right magnitude and the resistance-ignoring rightly stays prose.

Two activations hand the OWNER castable spells and the record has no innateSpells; both ids exist, occult is a legal tradition for each, and a heightened rank above the spell's base is already precedented (living-statue casts rank-2 sure-footing at rank 6).

A 6,000 gp weapon stored as itemType 'equipment' with no hands, category, group or damage, so it cannot be wielded or Struck with; the fix is the base kusarigama block verbatim (martial, knife, 1d8 slashing, held-in-two-hands, disarm/monk/reach/trip/versatile-b) and keeps the existing magical trait.

The gap is real (Foundry mis-tags its usage as 'held-in-one-hand', so import-core's parseRune never registers it) but the fix is a `rune` object, which is not a legal item field and has no applier lane — effect-backfill.json has no 'runes' category, so nothing would land. The real remedy is a code change in scripts/import-core.mjs (rune registration + a RUNE_DAMAGE entry), not a field on this record.

Text says it functions as a dagger but the record carries 1d6 slashing and no agile/finesse/thrown/versatile traits; the fix restores the dagger's real statistics, preserves the existing cursed/magical traits, and corrects an over-grant rather than creating one.
Invested graft granting a 1d6 piercing jaws Strike and the record carries no fields at all; grantedStrikes shape is identical to whip-tail's shipped entry.

The judge's own reason concedes nothing can write weapon traits from one item onto another, so a 17-option effectChoices would record a preference and deliver no mechanic — it fails the 'would actually deliver it' test, and the traits only ever matter on a shield Strike, which the augmentation explicitly does not otherwise alter.
